meta.title: feat: simplify Node.js runtime with Hono v1.17.0 absolute path support
meta.body_summary: Upgrade @hono/node-server to v1.17.0 and simplify static path handling from complex relative path calculation to direct absolute path, improving robustness and removing working directory dependency.

perf_labels.notes: Tiny PR upgrading dependency and simplifying path logic; merged quickly after bot-suggested code style improvement.

core_change_summary.description: Upgrade @hono/node-server to v1.17.0 for absolute path support. In backend/cli/node.ts, replace 10 lines of relative path calculation (join, relative, edge-case handling) with a single absolute path join(__dirname, '../static'). Remove unused 'relative' import. Apply ES6 property shorthand.
change_trajectory: Initial commit: upgrade @hono/node-server, simplify path logic, remove unused import.
Follow-up: apply Copilot shorthand suggestion for staticPath.
Further commit: apply shorthand consistently to cliPath as well.
